## Purpose

This document defines the governance structure for the project.
It applies to all contributors and reviewers.

## Scope

The scope covers EN↔RU translation quality and structural drift.
Translation is a core responsibility of all contributors.
Documentation ensures consistency across repositories.

| Feature | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Controlled-file deletion | active | Hyphenated text |
| Table body row | complete | No issues |

## Rules

Every change must pass the four phase-4 translation gates.
No exceptions for inline code or numerical literals.
